about_short_description.short_description: Optic is an open source project that brings smart code gen to your favorite IDEs.

product.name: Optic CLI
product.description: A command-line interface tool that captures API traffic to maintain and update OpenAPI specifications automatically.

product.name: Optic Diff
product.description: A tool that compares two versions of an OpenAPI specification to detect changes, check for breaking changes, and enforce API style guides.

product.name: Optic Run
product.description: A command that runs Optic’s full suite of API checks locally or in CI, validating OpenAPI specs, detecting breaking changes, and enforcing governance rules.

product.name: Optic CI (optic-ci)
product.description: An open-source CI tool that compares OpenAPI spec versions to catch breaking changes and enforce custom API rules during pull requests.

product.name: LintGPT
product.description: A tool that allows writing API style guides in natural language, which are then enforced automatically during API design and in CI.

product.name: OpenAPI Generation from Postman Collections
product.description: A process and toolset that uses Optic and Postman’s Newman CLI to generate and maintain OpenAPI specifications from Postman API collections.
